lines.japanese: 「春希くん？」
lines.english: “Haruki?”

lines.japanese: 「遅くなってごめん」
lines.english: “Sorry I’m late.”
February 28.

lines.japanese:
日中から夜にかけて、寒気が太平洋側までせり出し、
関東地方は厳しい寒さが予想される夜。
lines.english: Cold air had pushed all the way to the Pacific coast, with bitter temperatures forecast across Kanto from afternoon into night.

lines.japanese:
というか、今にも雪が降りそうなくらい、
厚い雲に覆われた、既にかなり寒い夜。
lines.english: Not that we needed the forecast. Thick clouds threatened snow at any moment, and the night was already bitterly cold.

lines.japanese:
「ううん、開始３０分前。
余裕でセーフだよ？」
lines.english: “You’re not late. We’ve still got thirty minutes. Plenty of time.”

lines.japanese: 「…うん」
lines.english: “…Right.”

lines.japanese:
そんな寒空の中、
小木曽家のインターフォンから聞こえてきた声は、
俺の全身をじわりと温めてくれた。
lines.english: Under that wintry sky, the voice coming through the Ogisos’ intercom slowly warmed me from head to toe.

lines.japanese: …まぁ、最近は毎日電話で温めてもらってるけど。
lines.english: Though lately her voice had been warming me over the phone every day.

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと待っててね。
今すぐに…あ、ちょっと！」
lines.english: “Wait right there. I’ll be down in—hey, wait!”

lines.japanese:
「いらっしゃいませ～。
ご新規様一名ご案内いたします～」
lines.english: “Welcome! Party of one, right this way!”
“………What?”

lines.japanese: ええと、改めて…
lines.english: All right. Let me try that again.

lines.japanese:
２月２８日。
２月最後の、寒い夜。
lines.english: February 28. The last cold night of February.

lines.japanese:
今日は、二週間遅れの…
雪菜の、誕生パーティ。
lines.english: Tonight was Setsuna’s birthday party. Two weeks late.

lines.japanese:
「お、やっと全員揃った～。
遅いよ北原さん」
lines.english: “Hey, now everybody’s finally here! You’re late, Kitahara.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、ごめん…でも」
lines.english: “Sorry. But…”

lines.japanese:
ほぼ二週間ぶりに上がらせてもらった
小木曽家のリビングは、
予想以上の人で溢れかえっていた。
lines.english: It had been almost two weeks since I had last set foot in the Ogisos’ living room, and now it was overflowing with far more people than I had expected.

lines.japanese:
おかげで外との気温差が違いすぎて、
とてもコートなんか着てられる状態では…
lines.english: The difference from outside was so extreme that keeping my coat on was out of the question.

lines.japanese:
「ごめんね春希くん。
びっくりしたでしょ？」
lines.english: “Sorry, Haruki. Did we surprise you?”

lines.japanese:
と、キッチンに立っていた雪菜が、
すぐに俺に寄り添いコートを取ってくれた。
lines.english: Setsuna left the kitchen, came straight to my side, and slipped the coat from my shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「…仲直りしたんだ」
lines.english: “…So you two made up.”

lines.japanese:
「してないよぅ！
なんでかわからないけど、
来ちゃってたんだよ…」
lines.english: “We did not! I don’t know why, but she just showed up…”

lines.japanese:
けれど今は二人とも、
お互いの顔を見つめ合ってたりはしない。
lines.english: For the moment, though, neither of them would even look at the other.

lines.japanese: 何しろ、そんなことより…
lines.english: They had more pressing business.

lines.japanese:
「あ～、なるほどぉ。
蒸して脂を落としちゃう訳だ」
lines.english: “Ohh, I get it. You steam it first so the fat renders out.”

lines.japanese:
「こうして下ごしらえしてからの方が美味しくなるし、
カロリーを気にしてるならこれで一石二鳥」
lines.english: “It tastes better if you prepare it this way, and if you’re watching your calories, it kills two birds with one stone.”

lines.japanese:
「や～、すっごいおばさん！
ホントありがと。今度やってみるね！」
lines.english: “Mrs. Ogiso, you’re amazing! Thank you so much. I’m definitely trying that next time.”

lines.japanese:
「あ～、もう、朋ちゃんって素直でいいコねぇ…
雪菜なんかわたしがいくら言っても、
『そんなのわかってるよ、うるさいなぁ！』なんて…」
lines.english: “Oh, Tomo, you’re such a sweet girl. You actually listen. No matter what I tell Setsuna, all I get is, ‘I know, Mom! Stop nagging me!’”

lines.japanese:
「また教えてもらいに来ちゃおっかな～。
あ、もちろん迷惑じゃなければ、だけど」
lines.english: “Maybe I’ll come back for another lesson. Only if I wouldn’t be imposing, of course.”

lines.japanese:
「迷惑だなんてとんでもない！　いつでもいらっしゃい。
素直だし、家庭的だし、何より雪菜よりよっぽど可愛いし。
あ～あ、わたしは産む子を間違えたわねぇ」
lines.english: “Imposing? Never! Come whenever you like. You listen, you’re good around the house, and most important, you’re much cuter than Setsuna. Honestly, I gave birth to the wrong daughter.”

lines.japanese:
「やだも～。
わたしなんかせっちゃんに叶う訳ないじゃないですか～。
いちお～去年のミス峰城ではありますけど～」
lines.english: “Oh, stop! Little old me could never compete with Setty. Though I was Miss Houjou last year, technically.”

lines.japanese:
「これからも雪菜と仲良くしてあげてね？
あの子、ああ見えて友達少なくて…」
lines.english: “Please keep being a good friend to Setsuna. She may not look it, but she doesn’t have many friends…”

lines.japanese:
「まっかせといてくださいって！
あ、それでこれの味付けなんですけど～」
lines.english: “Leave that to me! Oh, and about seasoning this…”

lines.japanese: 「…コート、置いてくるね」
lines.english: “…I’ll go put your coat away.”

lines.japanese:
あまりの展開に胸焼けしまくってそうな雪菜が、
もはや呆れも通り越しつつ、奥の部屋へと消えていく。
lines.english: The sheer sweetness of it all had clearly given Setsuna heartburn. Beyond even exasperation, she disappeared into the back room.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても、誰が…」
lines.english: “But who told everyone…?”

lines.japanese:
「いや、ま～。
今日のことをリークしたのはあたしらだけど…」
lines.english: “Well, okay. We were the ones who leaked the news about tonight…”

lines.japanese: 「…何のつもりだよ？」
lines.english: “…What were you thinking?”

lines.japanese:
「…色々あったんだよ。
そりゃもう、逆の意味で誰も信じられなくなるような、
衝撃的な出来事とかな」
lines.english: “…A lot happened. Shocking things. The kind that make you wonder if you ever knew anyone at all—in a good way, for once.”

lines.japanese:
「やめときな武也…
あの現場を見てなくて、
真実にたどり着ける奴なんかいないよ」
lines.english: “Don’t even try, Takeya. Nobody who wasn’t there would ever guess what really happened.”

lines.japanese: 「む、むぅ…」
lines.english: “Hmmm…”

lines.japanese: 本当に何があったんだこいつら…
lines.english: What the hell happened to these people…?

lines.japanese:
依緒なんて、前に彼女と話したときは、
掴みかからんばかりの勢いだったってのに。
lines.english: The last time Io spoke to Tomo, she had looked ready to grab her by the collar.

lines.japanese:
「ま、それよりもさ、
春希、満喫してるか？」
lines.english: “Never mind that. Haruki, are you enjoying yourself?”

lines.japanese: 「来たばっかだし始まってもいないだろ」
lines.english: “I just got here. The party hasn’t even started.”

lines.japanese:
「今日のことなんか誰も話してないって、
勘のいいあんたなら気づいてるよねぇ」
lines.english: “You’re perceptive enough to realize we haven’t mentioned the party once, aren’t you?”

lines.japanese:
「コンサート終わっても二日間手放さなかったんだって？
や～もう、俺ですら恥ずかしくなるくらい
らぶらぶだねぇ」
lines.english: “I hear you wouldn’t let her go for two whole days after the concert. You’re so disgustingly in love that even I’m embarrassed for you.”

lines.japanese:
「聞かせてよ聞かせてよ！
あんたたちの４８時間。
別に４８時間かけてもいいからさぁ」
lines.english: “Tell us, tell us! The whole forty-eight hours. Take another forty-eight hours if you need to.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ…」
lines.english: “Shut up…”

lines.japanese: 『色々世話になった。もう心配ない。ありがとう』
lines.english: “You two did so much for us. You don’t have to worry anymore. Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
…と、本来なら、
照れつつも真摯に感謝の意を表すところなんだろうけど、
こいつらはそういう素直な気持ちにさせない天才だな。
lines.english: That was where I should have thanked them sincerely, however embarrassed I felt. But these two were geniuses at making honest gratitude impossible.

lines.japanese:
「どうだろうねぇこの態度？
もし俺たちがいなかったらお前らどうなってたか…」
lines.english: “Listen to that attitude. If we hadn’t been there, who knows what would’ve happened to you two…”

lines.japanese:
「ま、あたしたちは
春希の恩知らずっぷりをよく知ってるからいいけどさ」
lines.english: “It’s fine. We’re well acquainted with Haruki’s breathtaking ingratitude.”

lines.japanese:
「俺もう今日は二度とお前らと話さん。
ついでに雪菜にも口止めしとくからな？」
lines.english: “I’m not speaking to either of you again today. And I’m warning Setsuna not to tell you anything.”

lines.japanese:
「俺たちはそれでいいけどさ、
一応、関係各所にはそれなりに挨拶しといた方が
いいんじゃないのか？」
lines.english: “Fine by us. But shouldn’t you at least offer a few words to the other interested parties?”

lines.japanese: 「関係各所って、他に誰が…」
lines.english: “What other interested parties?”

lines.japanese:
「色々とおめでとうございます。
…ここに来てるってことは、そういうことですよね？」
lines.english: “Congratulations on… everything. If you’re here, I assume that means what I think it does?”

lines.japanese: 「………で、なんで君らまでいるんだ？」
lines.english: “………And why are all of you here too?”

lines.japanese:
最初にリビングに来たときから、
身長的な関係で他の出席者に隠れてしまいつつも、
ぴょこぴょこ跳ねてるポニーテールだけは目に入ってた。
lines.english: I had noticed her the moment I entered—or at least her ponytail, bobbing above the taller guests every time she hopped in place.

lines.japanese:
「安心してください。美穂子は来てません。
…さすがにまだ気持ちの整理がついてないみたいで」
lines.english: “Don’t worry. Mihoko didn’t come. She still hasn’t quite sorted out her feelings.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、別に俺はそんなこと気にしてないぞ？」
lines.english: “I-I wasn’t worried about that.”

lines.japanese:
雪菜とは接点のないはずの、
俺のバイト先の後輩にして、
ほんのちょっとだけ、関係各所のうちの一つ…
lines.english: She was a younger coworker from my part-time job, someone who should have had no connection to Setsuna—and, in one very small sense, one of those interested parties herself.

lines.japanese:
「一応、わたしたちの卒業祝いと進学祝いも
同時開催ってことになってるんですよ。
明日だと湿っぽくなるから前日にやっちゃおうって」
lines.english: “This is also supposed to be our graduation and college-admission party. Everyone thought tomorrow might feel too sentimental, so we’re doing it the day before.”

lines.japanese: ついでに、孝宏君の関係各所…
lines.english: She was also Takahiro’s classmate, which gave her one more personal stake in all this.
lines.japaneseRuby: ついでに、孝宏君の[R関係各所^クラスメイト]…

lines.japanese: 「そっか…卒業式、明日だったっけ？」
lines.english: “Oh, right… graduation is tomorrow, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese: 「小木曽の合格発表は来週ですけどね」
lines.english: “Takahiro’s admission results don’t come out until next week, though.”

lines.japanese: 「…相変わらず楽天家だなぁ、孝宏君」
lines.english: “…Takahiro is as optimistic as ever.”

lines.japanese:
「わたしもそう思うんですよねぇ…
予備校探すとか二次募集探すとか
いろいろ考えることもあると思うんですけど」
lines.english: “That’s what I keep saying. You’d think he might consider finding a cram school or applying somewhere with a second round of admissions…”

lines.japanese:
「そして杉浦は相変わらず悲観的なお節介だな。
合格するって可能性を少しは考えてあげても…」
lines.english: “And Sugiura is as pessimistic and meddlesome as ever. Couldn’t you at least consider the possibility that he might pass?”

lines.japanese:
「わたし、勉強でもスポーツでもその他でも、
頑張った人が報われるって信じたいんです」
lines.english: “Whether it’s school, sports, or anything else, I want to believe that people who work hard get rewarded.”

lines.japanese: 「…少しは頑張ってただろ、彼も」
lines.english: “…He worked a little, didn’t he?”

lines.japanese:
「先輩も頑張ってましたよね。
コンサート、行きました。
…素敵でした」
lines.english: “You worked hard too. I went to the concert. It was… wonderful.”

lines.japanese:
「っ…あ………りがと。
その…色々世話になった。もう心配ない。ありがとう」
lines.english: “Oh… th-thank you. And… you did a lot for us. There’s nothing to worry about now. Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
その、突然俺に向けて放たれた真っ直ぐな牽制球に、
俺は照れつつも真摯に感謝の意を表してしまった。
lines.english: Koharu’s sudden, direct warning shot caught me off guard. Before embarrassment could stop me, I found myself thanking her in earnest.

lines.japanese:
「みんな、小木曽先輩ばかり注目してて、
ずっと先輩ばかり見てたのは、
多分、美穂子とわたしくらいだけど………あ」
lines.english: “Everyone was watching Ogiso, but Mihoko and I were probably the only ones watching you the whole time……… oh.”

lines.japanese:
「そ、そういえば杉浦、
君ら、卒業旅行が…」
lines.english: “S-speaking of which, Sugiura, wasn’t your graduation trip…”

lines.japanese:
とはいえ、その話題で引き続き勝負するには
分が悪すぎるので、俺は必死に話題を転換しようと…
lines.english: I had no chance if we kept sparring over that subject, so I desperately tried to change it.

lines.japanese: 「先輩…」
lines.english: “Kitahara…”

lines.japanese: 「な、なに？」
lines.english: “W-what?”

lines.japanese: 「…なんか雲行きが怪しいです」
lines.english: “…Looks like a storm’s brewing.”

lines.japanese:
「だって、今日はこれから雪だろ。
天気予報でも…」
lines.english: “Of course they are. It’s supposed to snow tonight. The forecast said—”

lines.japanese:
「わたし、さっきから小木曽先輩に
ものすごい勢いで睨まれてるんですけど…」
lines.english: “Ogiso has been glaring daggers at me for a while now…”

lines.japanese: ちょっと、忘れてた。
lines.english: I had briefly forgotten.

lines.japanese:
小春の視線の方に振り返ると、
そこにはあまりにも大人げない視線を突き刺しつつ、
頬を思いっきり膨らませた、不謹慎ながら随分と可愛い…
lines.english: I followed Koharu’s gaze. There stood Setsuna, fixing us with a spectacularly childish glare, her cheeks puffed out so far that—inappropriate as the thought was—she looked ridiculously cute.
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
なんて、やっぱりその不謹慎に勘付かれたか、
大きな足音を立てて二階へ上がってしまった
雪菜が…つまりさっきまでそこにいた。
lines.english: Maybe she sensed what I was thinking, because she stamped noisily upstairs. Which meant Setsuna had been standing there until a moment ago.

lines.japanese: 「追いかけた方がいいんじゃ…」
lines.english: “Shouldn’t you go after her?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あれは別にそう言うことじゃなくて…」
lines.english: “No, it isn’t anything like that…”

lines.japanese:
「今さら照れることでも
隠すことでもないと思うんですけど？」
lines.english: “It’s a little late to be embarrassed or pretend there’s something to hide, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese:
「………皆に余計なこと言うんじゃないぞ。
じゃ、ちょっと俺…」
lines.english: “………Don’t tell everyone anything unnecessary. I’m just going to…”

lines.japanese: 「ごゆっくり…」
lines.english: “Take your time.”

lines.japanese:
まったく雪菜は…
こんなとこで見境なくしてどうすんだ。
三つも下の杉浦の方がよっぽど大人の対応じゃないか。
lines.english: Honestly, Setsuna… Losing all sense of restraint here of all places? Sugiura was three years younger and had handled it far more maturely.

lines.japanese:
…ま、その分可愛げに満ち溢れてきたけれど。
最近の雪菜は。
lines.english: Still, that was exactly what had made Setsuna so impossibly cute lately.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅ………あ～、もう」
lines.english: “Whew……… honestly.”

lines.japanese:
「ね、ねぇねぇ小春！
あれってギターの人だよね？」
lines.english: “Koharu, Koharu! That was the guitarist, right?”

lines.japanese: 「…それが？」

「に、二階に上がってったよね？
しかも小木曽先輩と一緒に！
あ、あの二人ってもしかして、もしかしてっ」
lines.english: “He went upstairs, didn’t he? With Setsuna! Are those two… are they really…?”

lines.japanese:
「………わたしにそれを聞かないで。
知るわけないでしょそんなことっ」
lines.english: “………Don’t ask me. How would I know anything about that?”

lines.japanese: 「そんな大人げない目で睨まなくても…」
lines.english: “You don’t have to glare at us like that…”

lines.japanese: 「ん、んむ…ちゅ、んく、は、あ、あむ…」
lines.english: “Mmm… mm… ah… mmm…”

lines.japanese: 「ん、んぅ…あ、はぁ…」
lines.english: “Mmm… ah… haah…”

lines.japanese:
結局、雪菜がむくれていたのは
最初の三秒だけだった。
lines.english: In the end, Setsuna sulked for all of three seconds.

lines.japanese:
「は、あ、ぁ…ん、ちゅぷ…んぷぁ…ぁ…
は、春希…く…んぅっ、ん、ん…っ」
lines.english: “Ah… mmm… Haruki… mmm…”

lines.japanese:
ドアを閉めた途端、強引に抱きしめ唇を重ねると、
あっという間に甘い吐息とともに目を閉じて、
ゆっくりと俺に身を委ねてきた。
lines.english: The instant the door closed, I pulled her hard against me and kissed her. She closed her eyes almost at once, a sweet breath escaping her, and slowly let herself sink into my arms.

lines.japanese:
「ん、は、はぁ…あ、ああ…ん…ちゅ…ぅぅ…
は、はぁ、はぁぁ…ふぅ、ん…
あ～、一週間ぶり…ほんと、待ち遠しかったよ」
lines.english: “Mmm… hah… haah… a whole week. I could hardly wait.”

lines.japanese: 先週一週間、雪菜は外出禁止令を食らってた…
lines.english: Setsuna had spent the entire previous week grounded.

lines.japanese:
「けど…
この中座の仕方はあからさますぎないか？
俺たち、絶対なんか勘繰られてるぞ？」
lines.english: “But don’t you think leaving the party like that was a little obvious? Everyone downstairs is bound to suspect something.”

lines.japanese:
「勘繰られてても別にいいじゃない。
どうせ想像通りのことしてるんだから、
誤解、されてないでしょ？」
lines.english: “Let them. We’re doing exactly what they imagine, so it isn’t a misunderstanding, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「…お父さんはいい気しないと思うけど」
lines.english: “…Your father probably won’t be pleased.”

lines.japanese: 「今日は出ないよ。書斎に引きこもってる」
lines.english: “He isn’t coming out today. He’s shut himself in his study.”

lines.japanese: 「それはつまり…俺に会いたくないと…」
lines.english: “Meaning he doesn’t want to see me…”

lines.japanese:
雪菜が最初に与えられたペナルティは、
５日間の外泊と、無断でのコンサート出場に対しての、
春休み中の外泊禁止令だった。
lines.english: Setsuna’s original punishment for staying away from home for five days and performing at the concert without permission had been a ban on staying out overnight during spring break.

lines.japanese:
「いいんだよ春希くんが気を使わなくたって！
あんな酷いお父さんなんか！」
lines.english: “You don’t have to worry about him, Haruki! Not when he’s being this horrible!”

lines.japanese:
お父さんとしては、『もう大学生にもなった娘』に対して、
苦悩の末、十分過ぎるほど譲歩した上での
処分だったと思う。
lines.english: From her father’s point of view, it was an extraordinarily lenient punishment—one he had settled on only after agonizing over what to do with a daughter who was already in college.

lines.japanese:
「いや…俺の目から見ても、
随分と遠慮してたように思ったけど…」
lines.english: “Even from where I stood, he seemed to be going very easy on you…”

lines.japanese:
「どうして？
外出禁止なんて酷いよ！」
lines.english: “How? Grounding me was horrible!”

lines.japanese: 「それは雪菜が言いつけを破るから…」
lines.english: “That only happened because you broke the rules…”

lines.japanese:
「わたしだけが悪いって言うの？
春希くんだって…ちゃんと、したくせに」
lines.english: “Are you saying it was all my fault? You slept with me too, Haruki.”

lines.japanese:
ところが先週末、
雪菜は朝から俺の部屋に来て三食振舞ってくれた挙げ句、
帰るよう諭す俺の前で『夜モード』になってしまった。
lines.english: The previous weekend, Setsuna had arrived at my apartment in the morning, cooked all three meals, and then—just as I was trying to send her home—switched into “night mode.”

lines.japanese:
「するに決まってるだろ。
俺にそこまで高潔な自制心はない」
lines.english: “Of course I did. I don’t possess that kind of saintly self-control.”

lines.japanese:
その結果、とうとう堪忍袋の緒が切れたお父さんは、
雪菜が反省するまでという条件で、
外出禁止令を発令してしまった。
lines.english: That was the last straw for her father. He grounded Setsuna until she learned her lesson.

lines.japanese:
「…というわけで、
今夜、春希くんの部屋に行くね？」
lines.english: “…Which means I’ll come to your apartment tonight, all right?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、けどパーティ…」
lines.english: “But what about the party?”

lines.japanese:
「そこが狙い目なんだよ。
解散したときに、みんなを送るからって外に出て、
そのまま抜け出しちゃうの」
lines.english: “That’s what makes it perfect. When everyone leaves, I’ll go out to see them off—and simply keep going.”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese: 雪菜は…別の意味でも強くなってしまったかもしれない。
lines.english: Setsuna might have become stronger in more ways than one.

lines.japanese:
とにかく一度お父さんと直接ゆっくり話さないと。
誤解…はないけど理解だけはしてもらわないと…
lines.english: In any case, I needed to sit down with her father and talk this through. There was no misunderstanding, exactly. But I did need him to understand…
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「口の端っこ、濡れてる…」
lines.english: “The corner of your mouth is wet.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: それはもちろん、さっきまで唇を重ねていた痕跡で。
lines.english: Of course, it was from the kiss we had been sharing only a moment ago.

lines.japanese: 「わたし、ぬぐってあげる」
lines.english: “I’ll wipe it for you.”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese:
そんなものは、ハンカチか指先でちょっと拭けば、
すぐに元通りになる類のものなのに…
lines.english: It was the sort of thing a handkerchief or fingertip could have removed in an instant…

lines.japanese: 「れろ…ん、ちゅ…ちゅぷ…」
lines.english: “Mmm… mm… mmm…”

lines.japanese:
雪菜が取り出したのは、
ハンカチでもティッシュでもなく…
lines.english: But what Setsuna brought out was neither a handkerchief nor a tissue…

lines.japanese:
「あれ…また濡れちゃった。
おっかしいなぁ…」
lines.english: “Oh… now it’s wet again. How strange…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのな…」
lines.english: “L-Listen…”

lines.japanese:
「んんんんっ、ん、ん～っ！
ん、んぷ…は、はぁ、はぁぁ…あむっ」
lines.english: “Mmmmm! Mm… hah… mmph…”

lines.japanese: 「ん…ん、んぅ…ちゅ…は、あむ…れろ…」
lines.english: “Mmm… mm… ah… slurp…”

lines.japanese:
悪戯っぽくぺろりと出した舌がたまらなく、
ついついもう一度、それを求めて唇を重ねてしまう。
lines.english: The little tongue she flicked out so mischievously was irresistible. Before I knew it, I was kissing her again, searching for it.

lines.japanese: 「ん…んぷ…ちゅぷ、あ、あ…はぁぁんっ」
lines.english: “Mmm… mm… ah… haah…”

lines.japanese: やっぱり、雪菜は変わった。
lines.english: Setsuna truly had changed.

lines.japanese:
弱いようで強く、
優しいようで意地悪で、
控えめなようでワガママになった。
lines.english: She seemed weak but was strong, seemed kind but could be mean, seemed reserved but had grown selfish.

lines.japanese:
ただ、その変わった姿がすごく付属時代っぽいのが、
俺には、とてもとてもとても、嬉しい。
lines.english: And yet the person she had become felt so much like the Setsuna I had known in high school that it made me very, very, very happy.

lines.japanese: 「ん、んぅ、雪菜…ぁ」
lines.english: “Mmm… Setsuna…”

lines.japanese: 「はるき…くぅんっ…ん、んむ…ん～っ！」
lines.english: “Haruki… mmm!”

lines.japanese: ………そういうの、お父さんは理解してくれるだろうか？
lines.english: ………Would her father ever understand that side of her?

lines.japanese:
「さてと、それじゃ打ち合わせも済んだし、
いい加減、下に戻らないとね」
lines.english: “Well, we’ve settled everything, so we really ought to go back downstairs.”

lines.japanese:
脱走計画の打ち合わせが１０秒で、
それ以外の『突き合わせ』が１０分以上だった。
lines.english: We spent ten seconds going over the escape plan and more than ten minutes going at each other.

lines.japanese:
いくらなんでも、そろそろ下の連中も、
俺たちの目的を間違える方が難しくなってる頃だろう。
lines.english: By now, everyone downstairs would have had to work pretty hard to misunderstand what we had really been doing.

lines.japanese:
「じゃ、行こうか春希くん。
今日のローストビーフはね、結構自信作…」
lines.english: “Come on, Haruki. I’m rather proud of tonight’s roast beef…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、その前に…プレゼント」
lines.english: “Before we go… your present.”

lines.japanese: それでもあと１分だけは…
lines.english: Even so, I wanted just one more minute…

lines.japanese:
「あ、ありがと…
でもプレゼントはみんなの前で渡すことになってて…」
lines.english: “Th-thank you… But we agreed everyone would give me their presents downstairs…”

lines.japanese:
「駄目なんだ、これ…
色んな意味で他人には見せられないって言うか」
lines.english: “I can’t do that with this one. For several reasons, it isn’t something I can show anyone else.”
“What…?”

lines.japanese: 俺の差し出した小箱を前に、雪菜が固まる。
lines.english: Setsuna froze at the sight of the little box in my outstretched hand.

lines.japanese:
「結構、やっちゃった感があると言うか、
ちょっとでも退かれたらおしまいと言うか、
かなり痛いって言うか…」
lines.english: “I may have gone too far. If this puts you off even a little, I’m finished. And honestly… it may be painfully embarrassing.”

lines.japanese:
いや、たぶん正確には、
俺の言葉と、急に吹き出してきた額の汗に。
lines.english: More precisely, she froze at my words—and at the sudden sheen of sweat across my forehead.

lines.japanese: 「………開けてもいい？」
lines.english: “………Can I open it?”

lines.japanese: 「…うん」
lines.english: “…Yeah.”

lines.japanese:
雪菜がその包みを開いた瞬間…
買ったときの、あの緊張が蘇ってくる。
lines.english: As Setsuna unwrapped it, the anxiety I had felt when I bought it came rushing back.

lines.japanese: もう、三年も前になる、あの時の…
lines.english: The anxiety of that moment three years ago…

lines.japanese: 「あ…っ」
lines.english: “Ah…”

lines.japanese:
「その…実は結構古くて、しかも安物だけど、
一応綺麗にしたから」
lines.english: “It’s… actually pretty old, and it was cheap to begin with, but I had it cleaned.”

lines.japanese:
買ったときの値段とクリーニング代が、
実はほとんど変わらなかった…
lines.english: The cleaning had cost almost as much as the thing itself.

lines.japanese: 「人には、見せられないんだ」
lines.english: “I can’t show it to anyone.”

lines.japanese:
安いものだから。
古いものだから。
lines.english: Because it was cheap. Because it was old.

lines.japanese: そして………深い意味のある、ものだから。
lines.english: And because……… it meant so much.

lines.japanese:
「その…
一応、それが気に入らなかったときのために、
ちゃんと抑えも用意してる」
lines.english: “I brought a backup too, in case you didn’t like it.”

lines.japanese:
「や、やっぱこっちの方がいいかな？
同じ店でさっき買ったんだけど、
それよりも高いし、何より…」
lines.english: “M-Maybe this one would be better? I bought it from the same store today. It cost more than that one, and more importantly…”

lines.japanese: 「………嬉しい、よ」
lines.english: “………It makes me happy.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
「わたし、これがいい。
これでなくちゃ、駄目」
lines.english: “I want this one. Nothing else would do.”

lines.japanese: 「………ありがとう」
lines.english: “………Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
「プレゼントした方がありがとうって…
日本語の使い方、おかしいよ。
おかしいよ、春希くん………っ」
lines.english: “You’re giving me a present, and you’re thanking me? You’ve got that backward. Honestly, Haruki………!”
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: それは、満面の笑顔、だった。
lines.english: It was a smile that lit her whole face.

lines.japanese:
この際、目の色とか、そこに溜まってるものとか、
そんなことはどうでもいいんだ。
lines.english: The look in her eyes—and whatever had gathered there—didn’t matter now.

lines.japanese: だって、戻ってきたんだから。
lines.english: Because we had found our way back.

lines.japanese: 三年前の、あの誕生日に戻ってきたんだから…俺たち。
lines.english: The two of us had found our way back to that birthday three years ago…

lines.japanese: 「それじゃあ…」
lines.english: “Then…”
“Mm?”

lines.japanese: 「春希くんが…つけてくれる？」
lines.english: “Will you put it on me?”

lines.japanese:
そう言って、雪菜が…
『片方の手』を差し出した。
lines.english: With those words, Setsuna held out one of her hands.

lines.japanese: これが、俺たちの終章。
lines.english: This was our final chapter.

lines.japanese:
激しかった三年間を締めくくるには、
あまりにも穏やかで、尻すぼみの物語。
lines.english: After three stormy years, it was an almost absurdly quiet, anticlimactic conclusion.

lines.japanese:
だけどこれが、
これこそが…
lines.english: But this—this alone—

lines.japanese: 俺たちの、最高のエンディングなんだから。
lines.english: was the best ending we could ever have asked for.

lines.japanese:
「あ、姉ちゃんどこ行ってたんだよ？
もうとっくに準備できてるんだぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, Sis, where did you go? Everything’s been ready forever.”

lines.japanese:
「ごめんごめん。
ちょっと目にゴミが入っちゃって…」
lines.english: “Sorry, sorry. I got something in my eye…”

lines.japanese:
それは、目が赤いことに対しての、
上手くて、けれどバレバレな言い訳だった。
lines.english: It was a clever excuse for her red eyes—and one nobody could possibly believe.

lines.japanese:
「それじゃ始めよっか。
みんな～、飲み物注いで～。
…ねぇ母さん、今日は俺ワインいいよね？」
lines.english: “All right, let’s start. Everybody, fill your glasses! Mom, I can have wine tonight, right?”

lines.japanese:
「ほらせっちゃん。
グラスグラス」
lines.english: “Here, Setty. Your glass.”

lines.japanese: 「だからせっちゃんは
lines.english: “I told you, don’t call me Setty…

lines.japanese: ………もう、なんだかなぁ」
lines.english: ………Oh, forget it.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、あの、お姉さん、初めまして！
わたし、小木曽君のクラスメイトで…」
lines.english: “H-Hi! We haven’t met. I’m in Takahiro’s class, and…”

lines.japanese:
「清水早百合です！
あ、あの、コンサート見ましたっ。
あたし、すっごい感動しちゃって！」
lines.english: “I’m Sayuri Shimizu! I-I saw your concert. It moved me so much!”

lines.japanese:
「ありがとう。
ね、二人とも来年は峰城大に来るのかな？」
lines.english: “Thank you. Are you two coming to Houjou University next year?”
lines.japaneseRuby:
「ありがとう。
ね、二人とも来年は[R峰城大^うち]に来るのかな？」

lines.japanese:
「は、はいっ、
あたし外語で、このコが教育…」
lines.english: “Y-Yes! I’m going into Foreign Languages, and she’s going into Education…”

lines.japanese:
「そっかぁ…学部違うんだ、残念。
でも、大学で見かけたら声かけてね？
あ、そうだ、今度キャンパス案内しようか？」
lines.english: “Oh, you’ll be in different programs. That’s a shame. Still, say hello if you see me on campus. Actually, would you like me to show you around sometime?”

lines.japanese:
「えええっ、マジですか！？
本気にしちゃいますよ？」
lines.english: “Seriously!? I’ll hold you to that!”

lines.japanese:
「も、もう早百合…
わたしにも挨拶させてよっ」
lines.english: “S-Sayuri… let me introduce myself too!”

lines.japanese:
雪菜が、輪の中心へと戻っていくと、
途端に場がぱっと華やぐ。
lines.english: The moment Setsuna returned to the center of the gathering, the entire room seemed to brighten.

lines.japanese:
見た目的にはあんなに派手で、
いつも皆の注目を集めてる…
lines.english: She looked so glamorous and drew everyone’s attention wherever she went…

lines.japanese:
なのに性格的にも男の趣味的にもあんなに地味な、
これほどまでにアンバランスな女の子なんて、
他のどこにもいやしない。
lines.english: Yet she was so quiet by nature, and her taste in men so plain. Nowhere else in the world could there be another girl so wonderfully out of balance.

lines.japanese:
他の誰でもない、
俺の、俺だけの…
lines.english: No one else’s. Mine, and mine alone…

lines.japanese:
「このこの～。
なんだよあの薬指は～」
lines.english: “Well, well! What’s that on her ring finger?”

lines.japanese:
「三年待たせた分、飛ばしすぎてんな。
今のお前、かなり恥ずかしいぜ」
lines.english: “You made her wait three years, and now you’re moving awfully fast. You’re embarrassingly over the top.”

lines.japanese: 「………今日はお前らとは話さんって言っただろ」
lines.english: “………I told you I wasn’t speaking to either of you today.”

lines.japanese:
目ざとく雪菜の『左手』に気づいた奴らが、
俺の脇腹を肘で………かなり手加減無しでこづく。
lines.english: The two who had instantly spotted Setsuna’s left hand jabbed me in the ribs with their elbows—and with very little restraint.

lines.japanese: 「さてと、それじゃ乾杯の…」
lines.english: “All right, then. For the toast…”

lines.japanese: 「わ、雪！　雪降ってきたよ！」
lines.english: “Whoa, snow! It’s snowing!”

lines.japanese: 「え、どれどれ？　本当だ～！」
lines.english: “Where? Oh, it really is!”

lines.japanese:
ようやく始まるかと思われた誕生パーティは、
予想された突然の乱入者に中断を余儀なくされる。
lines.english: Just as the birthday party was finally about to begin, the gate-crasher we had been expecting brought it to a halt.

lines.japanese: 「うわぁ…すごい勢い…真っ白」
lines.english: “Wow… it’s coming down so hard. Everything’s white.”

lines.japanese: 「積もるね、これは絶対」
lines.english: “It’s going to stick. No question.”

lines.japanese: 「乾杯の…」
lines.english: “The toast…”

lines.japanese:
皆の歓声に応えるように、
窓の外の白い粒は、
自らの存在を誇示するように、強く、激しく舞う。
lines.english: As if answering everyone’s delight, the white flecks beyond the window danced harder and faster, making a spectacle of themselves.

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希くんも…」
lines.english: “Come look, Haruki…”

lines.japanese: 「うん…」
lines.english: “Yeah…”

lines.japanese:
窓の外を見上げてた雪菜が、
少しだけ銀色に光る左手を、俺に差し出す。
lines.english: Setsuna turned from the window and offered me her left hand, glinting faintly silver.

lines.japanese:
だから俺は…
当然のように空いていた雪菜の隣に、
ぴったりと寄り添うように立つ。
lines.english: So I took my natural place in the empty space beside her, standing close enough for our bodies to touch.

lines.japanese: 「綺麗、だね」
lines.english: “It’s beautiful.”
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: 明日から三月。
lines.english: Tomorrow would be March.

lines.japanese:
三月の月間予報によれば、今回の低気圧が過ぎた後は
急激に気温も高く、春めいた陽気になっていくらしい。
lines.english: The March forecast said temperatures would rise sharply once this low-pressure system passed, and the weather would begin to feel like spring.

lines.japanese:
だとしたらこれは、
多分、今シーズン最後の雪。
lines.english: If so, this was probably the last snow of the season.

lines.japanese: 冬が、終わる。
lines.english: Winter was ending.

lines.japanese:
三人の季節が、終わる。
『ＷＨＩＴＥ　ＡＬＢＵＭ』の季節が、終わる。
lines.english: The season that belonged to the three of us was ending. The season of White Album was ending.

lines.japanese: そして、俺たちの…
lines.english: And now our season was beginning…

lines.japanese: 二人だけの季節が、始まるんだ。
lines.english: a season for just the two of us.
